lines.en: Sideways is the steady way.
Eight legs, one shuffle.
Thin claw prints trail in the sand.
My shell scrapes the gravel.
I sidestep around the rock.
Step by step, no hurry.
The tide pulled back; I'll take a look.
My claw goes first.
I cross the whole shallows.
My leg joints click as I go.
I follow the waterline slowly.
I walk over my own shadow.
I squeeze through the gap in the rocks.
The low-tide flat is wide open.
I count the waves and shift along.
I travel with my body turned.
Droplets still hang on my shell.
Don't block my sideways road.
I crouch still in the sand.
Claws raised, I look dazed.
My eyes swivel this way and that.
Bubbles rise by my shell edge.
The wind blows; I tuck in a little.
Just staying put suits me.
The tide is going out; I can hear it.
Still as stone, that's the trick.
The water on my shell dries slowly.
Sleepy; my claws hang low.
I count how often the waves come.
Bubbles in the mud - likely food.
I'll wait for the tide to return.
Resting a moment, don't rush me.
Back off - my claws have a temper.
Both my eyes are on you.
Are you here to grab me?
I raise my claws for you to see.
Human, take half a step back.

lines.zh: 你的鞋印我数到第三道。
lines.en: I count your bootprints to the third line.
Don't kick my shell.
Your shadow is blocking my sun.
I edge sideways a little.
What? Never seen a crab?
My shell cracked! That hurts.
Who hit my back?
I pull in tight.
Stop hitting; I'm backing off.
One leg went numb.
The soft meat under my shell is showing.
Blood seeps from my joints.
I can't even walk straight sideways.
The pain loosened my claw.

lines.zh: 壳上裂了缝，我记住你的鞋。
lines.en: A crack in my shell, and I know your boot.
What is that smell in your hand?
Smells good; I'll come closer.
My claw is already reaching.

lines.zh: 用脚把它推过来，别弯腰。
lines.en: Push it over with your foot; don't bend.
I'm not picky; dropped scraps will do.
Is it food? Don't fool me.
That smell stops my legs.
I sidle closer, claws first.
Share a bite and I'll guard the flat.
It smells edible to me.
You bumped my shell.
Hey, watch where you walk.
This shell is hard; don't test it.
You shoved me sideways.
My claw caught your trouser leg.
Why squeeze? There's room beside me.
My leg is stuck by your boot.
One bump is enough.
Bump again and I'll pinch.
My shell clacked; no harm done.
Good tide for finding a mate.
I tap my shell with a claw.
You walk sideways too?
Let's shuffle a few steps together.

lines.zh: 我在沙上画个圈，我们横着绕。
lines.en: I draw a ring in the sand; we circle it sideways.
This is the season for pairing.
Raised claws are my greeting.
Wait for me in the sand hollow.
Your claws are a size bigger than mine.
Let's watch this flat together.
My claw can hold this.
Pick it up and hide it in the sand.
My claws are my pockets.

lines.zh: 这块亮片，卡进我的壳缝。
lines.en: This bright chip goes in my shell's crack.
Found a fine piece of shell.
This will line my burrow floor.
A gentle pinch; it won't break.
I drag it along sideways.
Who dropped this?
I'll keep it; might be useful.

lines.zh: 沙面一抖，我的眼就过去了。
lines.en: The sand twitches and my eyes go to it.
Claws open, ready to pinch.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到我洞口了。
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen over my burrow mouth.
Target fixed; closing in sideways.
Something is breathing in the wet sand.
Don't run; short legs, quick steps.
You'll do. Hold still.
Shell low, I charge.
Shell lowered - no more playing rock.
I already picked your escape route.
I circle you sideways.
My claws stay pointed at you.
You switch sides; I just sidestep too.
Don't try slipping around my flank.

lines.zh: 等你抬脚，我就横插过去。
lines.en: When you lift a foot, I cut across.

lines.zh: 你换气的时候，我数到空档。
lines.en: I count the pause each time you breathe.
I'm faster under the sand.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝离我没有半尺。
lines.en: Your ankle is not half a foot away.
My eyes don't blink.
Let's see who moves first.
The claw comes down!
Take a sideways pinch.
Shell against flesh; you lose.
I've got you; want me to let go?
This one will sting.
Don't reach in; you'll lose fingers.
A sideways charge into your knee.
The claw tip rakes past.
Back off! I can pinch again.
Let the sand decide it.
I claw my way up out of the sand.

lines.zh: 浪一退，我就被留在沙上。
lines.en: The wave pulls back and leaves me on the sand.
Plenty of rocks here.
My shell is still muddy.
The sunlight stings a little.
Another new flat to claim.
Let me shake out my legs.
Whose footprints are these?
The Jurassic wind blows just like this.
Steady now, then sideways.
Both claws still work.
This flat is mine.
Hot! My shell is cooking.
I fell from a height and landed on my shell.
Water floods my gills and I can't struggle.
The blast flipped me onto my back.
Something stuck into my shell.
That strange force seeps into my shell's seams.
Hunger makes my legs weak.

lines.zh: 雷落浅滩，我的腿全僵了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the shallows and locked my legs.
The ground vanished and I keep falling.
